AHD traces English pedal via Italian pedale and Latin pedalis to pes/ped- foot; the Latin etymological dictionary independently lists pedalis among pes derivatives. Source explicitly lists initial peda- as foot; botanical-zoological literature independently uses peda- as foot-like. This word begins with peda, so accept as a prefix-position same-family lookup variant, not as a claim that the Latin noun peda footprint directly gave rise to pedal.
